title: North Korean Troops Pull Back From Frontline in Russia: Ukraine Military
description: Soldiers from North Korea fighting on behalf of Moscow have reportedly pulled back from the frontline in Russia's Kursk region.

title: New Russian School Textbook Says Moscow 'Forced' Into War in Ukraine
description: A new history textbook for Russian teens claims Russia had no choice but to send troops into Ukraine in 2022.

title: Why Russia is unusually focused on praising the capture of the last Ukrainian stronghold in Donetsk
description: Two days back, Russia claimed its troops had captured Velyka Novosilka, a strategically important town in the Donetsk region in eastern Ukraine. The town is situated about 85 kilometres west of Donetsk.

title: EU Sanctions on Russia: Energy Tensions and Diplomatic Moves
description: The European Union extended its sanctions on Russia due to the ongoing war in Ukraine. Hungary had delayed the decision, seeking assurances on energy security. The renewed sanctions aim to disrupt Russia's finances, with profits from frozen assets aiding a loan to Ukraine. Diplomatic efforts continue amidst energy transit concerns.

title: Defectors offer insight into mindset of North Korean soldiers fighting in Ukraine
description: Multiple defectors from North Korea spoke to NBC News about the mindset of soldiers sent to fight for Russia in Ukraine.

title: Sanctioned North Korean arms makers find new cover in Russia’s shadow
description: A North Korean company started marketing its products with a reference to lessons learned in Russia's fight against Ukraine.

title: Geopolitics of LNG: The winners and the victims
description: How will US policy in Trump 2.0 impact global gas markets? What is liquified natural gas, and how do geopolitical factors such as the war in Ukraine and Western sanctions on Russia and Iran impact its global supply and trade?

title: Russia issues school textbook saying it was ‘forced’ to send troops into Ukraine
description: President Vladimir Putin casts the war as a difficult but necessary fight against a Western- and NATO-backed Ukraine

title: How Switzerland is caught up in Russia’s propaganda machine
description: How Russian propaganda challenges Switzerland's neutrality, using disinformation to sway public opinion in the Ukraine war.
